meanings.en: specific; this one and not any other
meanings.exampleEn: Is there a particular restaurant you would like to go to?
meanings.exampleTr: Gitmek istediğin belirli bir restoran var mı?

meanings.en: a strong supporter of a party or cause
meanings.exampleEn: He was a loyal partisan of the reform movement.
meanings.exampleTr: Reform hareketinin sadık bir yandaşıydı.

meanings.en: a relationship in which two parties work together
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies formed a successful partnership.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirket başarılı bir ortaklık kurdu.

meanings.en: having or showing strong feelings
meanings.exampleEn: She is passionate about protecting the environment.
meanings.exampleTr: Çevreyi korumak konusunda tutkulu biri.

meanings.en: in a way that shows strong feelings
meanings.exampleEn: He spoke passionately about the need for change.
meanings.exampleTr: Değişim ihtiyacı hakkında tutkuyla konuştu.

meanings.en: a minister in charge of a Christian church
meanings.exampleEn: The pastor welcomed the new members to the church.
meanings.exampleTr: Papaz yeni üyeleri kiliseye hoş geldiniz dedi.

meanings.en: relating to the countryside or country life
meanings.exampleEn: The painting showed a peaceful pastoral scene.
meanings.exampleTr: Resimde huzurlu, kırsal bir manzara vardı.

meanings.en: a small piece of material or area different from its surroundings
meanings.exampleEn: She sewed a patch over the hole in his jeans.
meanings.exampleTr: Kotunun deliğinin üzerine bir yama dikti.

meanings.en: in a calm way without becoming annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: She waited patiently for the doctor to call her name.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorun adını söylemesini sabırla bekledi.

meanings.en: a person who loves and supports their country
meanings.exampleEn: He was remembered as a true patriot who served his nation.
meanings.exampleTr: Milletine hizmet eden gerçek bir vatansever olarak hatırlandı.

meanings.en: showing love and support for your country
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd sang a patriotic song before the game.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık maçtan önce vatansever bir şarkı söyledi.

meanings.en: love of and devotion to one's country
meanings.exampleEn: Their patriotism was clear during the national celebrations.
meanings.exampleTr: Ulusal kutlamalar sırasında vatanseverlikleri belliydi.

meanings.en: a person who supports or regularly uses a place
meanings.exampleEn: The wealthy patron donated money to support young artists.
meanings.exampleTr: Varlıklı hami, genç sanatçılara destek olmak için para bağışladı.

meanings.en: to cover a surface with a hard material
meanings.exampleEn: The workers will pave the road with new asphalt.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler yolu yeni asfaltla kaplayacak.

meanings.en: a paved path at the side of a road for people to walk on
meanings.exampleEn: Pedestrians walked along the narrow pavement.
meanings.exampleTr: Yayalar dar kaldırım boyunca yürüdü.

meanings.en: the foot of an animal that has claws or nails
meanings.exampleEn: The dog hurt its paw on a sharp stone.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek pençesini keskin bir taşta yaraladı.

meanings.en: a person who lends money in exchange for items left as security
meanings.exampleEn: He took his watch to the pawnbroker to get some cash.
meanings.exampleTr: Biraz nakit almak için saatini rehinciye götürdü.

meanings.en: a shop where you can borrow money by leaving items as security
meanings.exampleEn: She sold her old guitar at the pawnshop.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski gitarını rehinci dükkânında sattı.

meanings.en: an amount of money paid, or the act of paying
meanings.exampleEn: We accept payment by credit card or cash.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredi kartı veya nakit ile ödeme kabul ediyoruz.

meanings.en: in a calm and quiet way, without violence
meanings.exampleEn: The baby slept peacefully through the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebek gece boyunca huzur içinde uyudu.

meanings.en: a round soft fruit with yellow-pink skin and a stone
meanings.exampleEn: She ate a ripe peach for dessert.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatlı olarak olgun bir şeftali yedi.

meanings.en: the highest point of something
meanings.exampleEn: They reached the peak of the mountain at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağın zirvesine şafakta ulaştılar.

meanings.en: a small, hard, round white object formed inside an oyster
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a beautiful necklace made of pearls.
meanings.exampleTr: İncilerden yapılmış güzel bir kolye takıyordu.

meanings.en: a small smooth stone
meanings.exampleEn: The children collected pebbles on the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sahilde çakıl taşları topladı.

meanings.en: a part you press with your foot to operate a machine
meanings.exampleEn: He pressed the brake pedal to stop the car.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabayı durdurmak için fren pedalına bastı.

meanings.en: too concerned with small details or rules
meanings.exampleEn: His pedantic corrections annoyed everyone in the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayrıntıya aşırı önem veren düzeltmeleri toplantıdaki herkesi rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: a person walking, especially in a town
meanings.exampleEn: The driver stopped to let the pedestrian cross.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürücü yayanın geçmesi için durdu.

meanings.en: to pass urine from the body (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: The dog stopped to pee against the lamppost.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek lamba direğine işemek için durdu.

meanings.en: the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable
meanings.exampleEn: She grated some lemon peel into the cake mixture.
meanings.exampleTr: Kek karışımına biraz limon kabuğu rendeledi.

meanings.en: a quick or secret look at something
meanings.exampleEn: She took a peep at the present hidden in the closet.
meanings.exampleTr: Dolapta saklı hediyeye kısa bir göz attı.

meanings.en: a short pin used to hang things or fasten them
meanings.exampleEn: He hung his coat on a peg by the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Paltosunu kapının yanındaki askıya astı.

meanings.en: to punish someone for breaking a rule or law
meanings.exampleEn: Drivers who speed will be penalized with a fine.
meanings.exampleTr: Hız yapan sürücüler para cezasıyla cezalandırılacak.

meanings.en: a punishment for breaking a rule or law
meanings.exampleEn: The penalty for late payment is a small extra fee.
meanings.exampleTr: Geç ödemenin cezası küçük bir ek ücrettir.

meanings.en: to enter or pass through something
meanings.exampleEn: The light could not penetrate the thick fog.
meanings.exampleTr: Işık yoğun sisin içine giremedi.

meanings.en: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly
meanings.exampleEn: A penguin slid across the ice toward the water.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir penguen buzun üzerinden suya doğru kaydı.

meanings.en: a type of antibiotic used to treat infections
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed penicillin for the infection.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor enfeksiyon için penisilin reçete etti.

meanings.en: money paid regularly to someone who has retired
meanings.exampleEn: He lives on a small pension after retiring last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen yıl emekli olduktan sonra küçük bir emekli maaşıyla geçiniyor.

meanings.en: a flat shape with five straight sides
meanings.exampleEn: The students drew a pentagon in their geometry class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler geometri dersinde bir beşgen çizdi.

meanings.en: to notice or become aware of something
meanings.exampleEn: Many people perceive him as a strong leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok kişi onu güçlü bir lider olarak algılıyor.

meanings.en: an amount expressed as a part of a hundred
meanings.exampleEn: A large percentage of students passed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilerin büyük bir yüzdesi sınavı geçti.

meanings.en: the way you notice or understand something
meanings.exampleEn: His perception of the situation was quite accurate.
meanings.exampleTr: Durumla ilgili algısı oldukça doğruydu.

meanings.en: the state of lasting for a long time or forever
meanings.exampleEn: The permanence of the changes reassured the workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Değişikliklerin kalıcılığı işçileri rahatlattı.

meanings.en: to spread throughout something
meanings.exampleEn: The smell of coffee permeated the whole house.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahve kokusu tüm eve yayıldı.

meanings.en: continued effort to do something despite difficulties
meanings.exampleEn: Her perseverance helped her finish the marathon.
meanings.exampleTr: Azmi maratonu bitirmesine yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: to continue to do something despite difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağrı devam ederse bir doktora görünmelisin.

meanings.en: the quality of continuing despite difficulties
meanings.exampleEn: Her persistence finally led to success.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararlılığı sonunda onu başarıya götürdü.

meanings.en: continuing firmly or lasting a long time
meanings.exampleEn: She had a persistent cough that lasted for weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Haftalarca süren ısrarlı bir öksürüğü vardı.

meanings.en: the representation of an idea as a person or human quality
meanings.exampleEn: The poem uses personification to describe the wind.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, rüzgârı betimlemek için kişileştirme kullanır.

meanings.en: to represent an idea as a person or be a perfect example of it
meanings.exampleEn: She seemed to personify kindness and patience.
meanings.exampleTr: Nezaketi ve sabrı kişileştiriyor gibiydi.

meanings.en: the people who work for an organization
meanings.exampleEn: All military personnel must follow strict rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm askeri personel katı kurallara uymalıdır.

meanings.en: a particular way of viewing or thinking about something
meanings.exampleEn: Travelling gave her a new perspective on life.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahat etmek ona hayata dair yeni bir bakış açısı kazandırdı.

meanings.en: the liquid that comes out through the skin; sweat
meanings.exampleEn: Perspiration ran down his face during the run.
meanings.exampleTr: Koşu sırasında yüzünden ter aktı.

meanings.en: the act of making someone agree or believe something
meanings.exampleEn: After much persuasion, he agreed to join us.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok ikna ettikten sonra bize katılmayı kabul etti.

meanings.en: a person who expects bad things to happen
meanings.exampleEn: He is such a pessimist that he expects everything to fail.
meanings.exampleTr: Öyle bir karamsar ki her şeyin başarısız olacağını düşünür.

meanings.en: expecting bad things to happen
meanings.exampleEn: She felt pessimistic about her chances of winning.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazanma şansı konusunda karamsardı.

meanings.en: extremely frightened, unable to move
meanings.exampleEn: She was petrified when she saw the snake.
meanings.exampleTr: Yılanı gördüğünde korkudan donup kaldı.

meanings.en: small and unimportant; concerned with trivial matters
meanings.exampleEn: They argued over petty details that did not matter.
meanings.exampleTr: Önemli olmayan önemsiz ayrıntılar üzerine tartıştılar.

meanings.en: a measure of how acidic or alkaline a substance is
meanings.exampleEn: The gardener tested the pH of the soil before planting.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçıvan ekim yapmadan önce toprağın pH değerini ölçtü.

meanings.en: a person who prepares and sells medicines
meanings.exampleEn: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
meanings.exampleTr: Eczacı ilacın nasıl kullanılacağını açıkladı.

meanings.en: a stage in a process of change or development
meanings.exampleEn: The project is now entering its final phase.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje şimdi son aşamasına giriyor.

meanings.en: relating to philosophy or to serious thought
meanings.exampleEn: They had a long philosophical discussion about life.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayat hakkında uzun, felsefi bir tartışma yaptılar.

meanings.en: a medical doctor, especially one who is not a surgeon
meanings.exampleEn: The physician recommended more rest and exercise.
meanings.exampleTr: Hekim daha fazla dinlenme ve egzersiz önerdi.

meanings.en: a number (about 3.14) used to calculate circles
meanings.exampleEn: We used pi to find the area of the circle.
meanings.exampleTr: Dairenin alanını bulmak için pi sayısını kullandık.

meanings.en: a vegetable preserved in vinegar or salt water
meanings.exampleEn: He added a slice of pickle to his sandwich.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandviçine bir dilim turşu ekledi.

meanings.en: very careful about choosing what you like
meanings.exampleEn: He is a picky eater and refuses most vegetables.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek konusunda seçici biri ve çoğu sebzeyi reddediyor.

meanings.en: attractive in a charming, old-fashioned way
meanings.exampleEn: They stayed in a picturesque village in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlardaki resim gibi güzel bir köyde kaldılar.

meanings.en: a cloth cover for a pillow
meanings.exampleEn: She changed the pillowcase before her guest arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Misafiri gelmeden önce yastık kılıfını değiştirdi.

meanings.en: a thin pointed piece of metal used to fasten things
meanings.exampleEn: She used a pin to hold the two pieces of fabric together.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kumaş parçasını bir arada tutmak için bir iğne kullandı.

meanings.en: a tall evergreen tree with needle-shaped leaves
meanings.exampleEn: The air smelled fresh among the tall pine trees.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun çam ağaçları arasında hava taze kokuyordu.

meanings.en: a unit of measurement for liquids, about half a litre
meanings.exampleEn: He bought a pint of milk from the shop.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkândan bir pint süt aldı.
